<p class="project-page-intro">
Operator-level performance work across CUDA C++, Triton, and CuTe DSL.

<div class="project-stack">
  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/cross_dsl_kernels" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">GPU Kernel Optimization for LLM Inference</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">FP32 RMSNorm and GEMV/small-M GEMM in CUDA C++ and Triton on RTX 5050. Fused residual add, RMS reduction, and scaling from seven eager PyTorch launches to one at 256 × 4096; passed 80/80 backend-shape checks. Row tiling and split-K accelerated two M=16 Triton projections 15.3–16.3× versus earlier implementations using CUDA Graph medians.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/triton-flash-attention" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">Triton FlashAttention-2: Forward Attention</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">Online softmax without the N × N score matrix, FP16 MHA/GQA at head dimensions 32/64/128, and causal/partial-tile masking. Validated 60/60 cases against PyTorch SDPA; measured 255 registers/thread and 8.3% occupancy at D=128 with Nsight profiling.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/GPU-Mode/tree/main" target="_blank" rel="noopener">

    <span class="project-row-meta">Agentic CUDA workflow, batched FP32 Householder QR, Modal/Popcorn runs, and 23.7% local geomean reduction</span>
